summary: This note describes the early operations of the Twenty-First Army (Japan). It records the landing of the 18th and 104th Divisions on October 12, followed by command units the next day. It then traces the advance: Guangzhou was under Japanese control by October 21, the IJA 5th Division took Foshan by November 5, and the entire province was under Japanese control by the end of November.
one_line: Chronology of the Japanese Twenty-First Army's landings and advance that took Guangzhou, Foshan and the whole province by late November.
key_facts: The 18th and 104th Divisions landed on October 12.
Command units of the Twenty-First Army landed the day after the divisions, on October 13.
By October 21, the provincial capital of Guangzhou was under Japanese control.
The IJA 5th Division continued to advance up the Pearl River after Guangzhou fell.
By November 5, the IJA 5th Division had taken the city of Foshan.
By the end of November, the entire province was under Japanese control.
Guangzhou is described in the note as a provincial capital.
Foshan is described in the note as a city taken by the IJA 5th Division.
The advance toward Foshan was made by moving up the Pearl River.
The note covers a campaign of roughly six weeks, from October 12 to the end of November.
